sources.excerpt: The policy is successfully spurring the use of recycled plastic, even as thresholds and categories increase, said APR’s Kate Bailey. But some companies, such as Ocean Spray, continue to use no PCR and face penalties.

title: BPI responds to organic compost coalition

sources.title: BPI responds to organic compost coalition
